AdvzCommon.description:
Parameters of the legacy ADVZ scheme. The two commitments are ark-serialized, one TaggedBase64
`FIELD~` each, exactly as v1 renders them

polyCommits.description: KZG commitments to the payload polynomials, all in one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

AdvzMerkleNode.description:
One node of a jellyfish Merkle proof. v1 spells the third arm `ForgettenSubtree`, which is
upstream's misspelling; only the wire name here is corrected.

value.description: The branch's hash, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

AdvzMerkleNodeEmpty.description: A missing subtree. The arm is present and its object empty

value.description: The subtree's hash, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

elem.description: The leaf element, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

pos.description: The leaf's index, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

value.description: The leaf's hash, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

pos.description: The index this proof is for, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

nsIndex.description: Position of the namespace in the namespace table, 4 bytes

nsPayload.description: The namespace's bytes, base64 in JSON

nsProof.description: Absent when the namespace is empty

AdvzTxProof.description:
Legacy ADVZ inclusion proof. jellyfish keeps the range proofs private, and the index and table
entries are v1 byte encodings, so every field is read through v1's own JSON

payloadNumTxs.description: Transaction count of the namespace, in its payload byte encoding

payloadProofTx.description: Absent when the transaction is empty

payloadTxTableEntries.description: The transaction's table entries, in their payload byte encoding

txIndex.description: Position of the transaction in its namespace, 4 bytes

AdvzVidShare.description: Legacy ADVZ share, which only a 0.1 or 0.2 block carries

evals.description:
ark-serialized, one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`. jf-advz documents this as carrying nothing
meaningful; it is served for v1 parity

index.description: Which storage node's share this is

ApiModules.description:
Which API modules the node serves. A module that is off answers 404 for every route it owns,
so a client can tell a disabled module from a missing one

nsCommit.description: Commitment the shares were checked against, TaggedBase64 `AvidMCommit~`

nsIndex.description: Position of the namespace in the namespace table

nsMtProof.description: Proof of the namespace commitment in the payload commitment, TaggedBase64 `MERKLE_PROOF~`

AvidmBadEncodingProof.description:
Evidence that an AvidM disperser encoded a namespace incorrectly: the polynomial recovered from
the shares, and the shares' Merkle proofs against the commitment that does not match it

rawShares.description: (share index, Merkle proof) pairs, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

recoveredPoly.description: Field elements, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

AvidmCommon.description:
The two AvidM schemes' parameters and transaction proofs have the same shape today but are
separate messages, since the field numbers freeze per scheme and the schemes are versioned
independently

nsLens.description: Payload bytes per namespace, aligned with ns_commits

payload.description:
One entry per shard in the range, each the shard's raw bytes. Base64 in JSON, where v1
served an array of numbers

txIndex.description: Position of the transaction in its namespace, 4 bytes

namespaces.description: One entry per namespace of the block

mtProofs.description: The share's Merkle proofs, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

payload.description: The share's field elements, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

txIndex.description: Position of the transaction in its namespace, 4 bytes

AvidmVidShare.description:
Both AvidM schemes disperse per namespace, so a share carries one entry per namespace of the
block rather than one for the whole payload. The per-namespace lists line up only for a share
that passed VID verification, which this endpoint does not repeat.

content.description: One entry per namespace, aligned with ns_commits

index.description: Which storage node's share this is

nsLens.description: Payload bytes in each namespace, aligned with ns_commits

height.description: Height of the latest decided block

hash.description: Hash of the header, which is how a block is identified. TaggedBase64 `BLOCK~`

amount.description:
Reward distributed per block, in wei (decimal string); absent when the node does not know
a reward for the epoch

namespaces.description:
Per-namespace transaction count and byte size, keyed by namespace id. A namespace with no
transactions in this block is absent

r.description: 0x-prefixed hex quantity, so shorter than 64 digits when it has leading zeros

s.description: 0x-prefixed hex quantity, so shorter than 64 digits when it has leading zeros

BuilderType.description:
- `BUILDER_TYPE_EXTERNAL`: Blocks come from the builders at `builder_urls`
- `BUILDER_TYPE_SIMPLE`: Each node runs its own builder
- `BUILDER_TYPE_RANDOM`: Each node runs a builder that produces random transactions

Certificate2.description: The new protocol's phase-2 certificate, which finalizes a leaf

baseFee.description: Smallest fee in wei per payload byte. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

chainId.description: Espresso chain ID. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string rather than an integer

feeContract.description:
L1 fee contract; absent while fees are switched off, so that turning them off needs no
deployment

feeRecipient.description: Account credited with every sequencing fee, whether or not a fee contract is deployed

stakeTableContract.description:
L1 stake table proxy; absent while proof of stake is switched off, so that turning it off
needs no deployment, and always absent on a 0.1 or 0.2 header, whose chain config predates
the field

amount.description:
Circulating supply of ESP tokens on Ethereum L1, in ESP (decimal string):
total_supply_l1 - locked

Circulating supply in ESP (decimal string): initial_supply + reward_distributed -
locked, following the mainnet unlock schedule

delayDurationMs.description: Wait before a message also goes out over the secondary network

targetUsage.description: Bytes retained before garbage collection gets more aggressive

variables.description: Only the variables the node's public-env-vars.toml allowlists

value.description: Empty when unset or set to the empty string, which are not distinguished

Error.description: Error response following the Google API error model

account.description: Account charged for sequencing the block

amount.description: Fee paid in wei. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

HeaderResponse.description:
The arm names the protocol version that produced the header. Versions sharing a shape share a
message: 0.2 uses the 0.1 shape and 0.6 and 0.7 the 0.5 shape

HeaderV1.description: The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.1, also used by 0.2

builderSignature.description:
Evidence that fee_info is correct. Absent when the builder did not sign, and never part of
the header commitment, since consensus has already checked it

l1Finalized.description: Latest L1 block finalized when the block was proposed; absent when none was

l1Head.description: L1 block this header was built against

HeaderV3.description: The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.3, which added the reward merkle tree

builderSignature.description:
Evidence that fee_info is correct. Absent when the builder did not sign, and never part
of the header commitment, since consensus has already checked it

l1Finalized.description: Latest L1 block finalized when the block was proposed; absent when none was

l1Head.description: L1 block this header was built against

rewardMerkleTreeRoot.description: Root of the first reward merkle tree. TaggedBase64 `MERKLE_COMM~`

HeaderV4.description:
The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.4, which moved to the second reward merkle
tree and added millisecond timestamps, distributed rewards and the next stake table hash

builderSignature.description:
Evidence that fee_info is correct. Absent when the builder did not sign, and never part
of the header commitment, since consensus has already checked it

l1Finalized.description: Latest L1 block finalized when the block was proposed; absent when none was

l1Head.description: L1 block this header was built against

nextStakeTableHash.description:
Stake table taking effect next epoch. TaggedBase64 `STAKE_TABLE~`. Absent outside an epoch
boundary

rewardMerkleTreeRoot.description:
Root of the second reward merkle tree, which replaced the first in this version.
TaggedBase64 `MERKLE_COMM~`

timestampMillis.description:
Unix milliseconds. Clamped separately from `timestamp`, so it is not guaranteed to be
`timestamp * 1000`

totalRewardDistributed.description: Rewards distributed since genesis, in wei. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

HeaderV5.description:
The header shape introduced in protocol version 0.5, which added leader counts. Also used by
0.6 and 0.7

builderSignature.description:
Evidence that fee_info is correct. Absent when the builder did not sign, and never part
of the header commitment, since consensus has already checked it

l1Finalized.description: Latest L1 block finalized when the block was proposed; absent when none was

l1Head.description: L1 block this header was built against

leaderCounts.description:
Blocks each validator proposed this epoch, indexed by its position in the epoch's stake
table. A view whose leader proposed nothing is not counted. Always 100 entries, the cap on
the active validator set

nextStakeTableHash.description:
Stake table taking effect next epoch. TaggedBase64 `STAKE_TABLE~`. Absent outside an epoch
boundary

payloadCommitment.description:
TaggedBase64. `AvidMCommit~` on 0.5 and `AvidmGf2Commit~` on 0.6, which share this
message

rewardMerkleTreeRoot.description:
Root of the second reward merkle tree, which replaced the first in 0.4.
TaggedBase64 `MERKLE_COMM~`

timestampMillis.description:
Unix milliseconds. Clamped separately from `timestamp`, so it is not guaranteed to be
`timestamp * 1000`

totalRewardDistributed.description: Rewards distributed since genesis, in wei. A 256-bit number, so a decimal string

next.description:
The header after the window. Absent both when the window reaches the chain tip and when it
was truncated at the limit `/v2/node/limits` reports, so a `window` of exactly that many
entries means there is more to fetch rather than nothing after it

prev.description: The header before the window, absent at the start of the chain

window.description: Headers whose timestamps fall in the window

HotshotConfigResponse.description:
The consensus parameters this node runs with.

v1 wraps these in the orchestrator's `NetworkConfig`, which repeats several of the timings and
the bootstrap count at the outer level with the values the orchestrator was configured with
rather than the ones consensus runs on. Only the operative values are served here. Also not
carried over: the orchestrator's own run parameters (`seed`, `node_index`, `rounds`,
`transactions_per_round`, `transaction_size`, `random_builder`), its masked
`manual_start_password`, and `key_type_name`, which names a Rust type.

In the four upgrade windows below, a stop at or before its start means this node does not
propose, or does not vote for, the upgrade at all. A time bound of 0 or 18446744073709551615
(u64::MAX) means the window is not bounded in time

builderTimeoutMs.description: Longest a leader waits for a builder's block before proposing without one

builderUrls.description: Builders consensus runs with: `--builder-urls` when given, else the network config's

cdnMarshalAddress.description: Absent unless the node reaches the CDN through a marshal

combinedNetworkConfig.description: Absent unless the node runs the combined network

commitSha.description: Git SHA the node was built from; empty when the build stamped none

daCommittees.description: DA committee overrides that take effect at a given version and epoch

dataRequestDelayMs.description: Wait before requesting the data behind a proposal from peers

drbUpgradeDifficulty.description: Iterations of the DRB computation after the DRB upgrade

epochHeight.description: Blocks per epoch; zero before proof of stake

indexedDa.description: When true the first nodes to register form the DA committee; when false a node asks to join

knownNodesWithStake.description:
Every node the network was started with, with its stake and network address. The live stake
table is served by `/v2/node/stake-table`; this is the genesis membership

numBootstrap.description: How many bootstrap nodes this node dials on startup

stakeTableCapacity.description: Stake table size the light-client circuit is built for

startProposingTime.description: Unix seconds from which this node proposes a consensus upgrade

startProposingView.description: View from which this node proposes a consensus upgrade

startThresholdNumerator.description:
Fraction of nodes, by count rather than by stake, that the orchestrator waits for before
signalling the start of consensus. Nodes joining through config peers never consult it

startVotingTime.description: Unix seconds from which this node votes for a consensus upgrade

startVotingView.description: View from which this node votes for a consensus upgrade

tonicPort.description: Absent unless the node also serves v2 over gRPC

hash.description: 32-byte block hash, 0x-prefixed and always 64 hex digits, not a quantity

timestamp.description: Unix seconds, hex-encoded as on v1 rather than decimal

LargeRangeProof.description: A jellyfish range proof over a namespace's bytes, as v1 encodes it

prefixElems.description: Field elements, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

suffixElems.description: Field elements, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

blockPayload.description: Absent from served leaves: the payload is stored and fetched separately

justifyQc.description: The QC this leaf chains from

nextDrbResult.description: 32-byte DRB result for the next epoch, base64 in JSON, only on an epoch's last block

nextEpochJustifyQc.description: Formed by the next epoch's nodes, only on the leaves that hand over an epoch

upgradeCertificate.description: Only when the proposal for this view carried one

viewChangeEvidence.description: Only when the justify QC is not from the preceding view

withEpoch.description: Whether epochs were enabled when this leaf was proposed

qc.description: The QC that certifies this leaf

lcPath.description: Absent when the light-client database is in memory

largeObjectRangeLimit.description:
Most objects one range query may load from the large-object class: blocks, payloads, headers
and block summaries, anything served by loading a payload. The class decides the limit,
objects are not measured individually

smallObjectRangeLimit.description:
Most objects one range query may load from the small-object class: leaves and VID common.
Headers and block summaries are served by loading their whole block, so they count as large

completedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; absent while the migration is still running

lastOffset.description:
Offset of the last processed batch. The runner writes 0 when it registers the migration and
updates this after every batch, so a migration it tracks always carries one

size.description: Size of this namespace's share of the payload, in bytes

proof.description: Absent when the block has no such namespace

transactions.description: The namespace's transactions, in block order

height.description: The current height of the chain as this node sees it

icon14x141x.description: Operator-supplied logos for public dashboards, at two sizes and three pixel densities

nodeType.description: Binary name and version unless the operator overrode it

ethAccount.description: Ethereum account associated with this node, 0x-prefixed hex

p2pAddr.description: Cliquenet address peers dial, host:port: the configured advertise address, unset when none is configured

x25519Key.description: X25519 public key for cliquenet, TaggedBase64

windowLimit.description: Most headers a header window request may return

NodeStorage.description:
`fs` and `sql` follow `backend`, and both are absent when the default filesystem backend was
never given a path

NsProof.description: The arm names the VID scheme, and v1_incorrect_encoding is an AvidM block whose disperser cheated

NsProofPayload.description: A namespace's proof against the payload commitment, for the AvidM and AvidmGf2 schemes

nsIndex.description: Position of the namespace in the namespace table

nsPayload.description: The namespace's bytes, base64 in JSON

nsProof.description: Merkle proof of those bytes, TaggedBase64 `MERKLE_PROOF~`

bytes.description: The namespace table in its canonical byte encoding, base64 in JSON

participation.description: From 0 to 1; see the rpc for what it is a fraction of
Sorted by key; v1 reports a map, which has no order

rawPayload.description: The block's transactions in their canonical byte encoding, base64 in JSON

hash.description: VID commitment to the payload, the TaggedBase64 tag names the VID scheme

connectInfo.description: Absent for a peer that published no network address

p2pAddr.description: "host:port", with an IPv6 literal left unbracketed as v1 writes it

x25519Key.description: X25519 public key for cliquenet, TaggedBase64 rather than x25519's own base58

PruningConfig.description: Retention policy for the archival tables. Durations are whole milliseconds, rounded down

maxUsage.description: Disk usage in basis points, so 8000 is 80%

pages.description: SQLite pages vacuumed from the freelist per pruner cycle; unused on Postgres

pruningThreshold.description: Disk usage, in bytes, above which pruning starts

peers.description: Peers this node fetches missing data from

QuorumCertificate2.description:
A certificate is its voted data plus the signatures over the commitment of that data. One
message per data type, the shape is otherwise the same

signatures.description: Absent on the genesis certificate, which nobody signed

voteCommitment.description: Commitment to the versioned vote, which the signatures are over. TaggedBase64 `COMMIT~`

leafCommit.description: Commitment to the leaf voted on, TaggedBase64 `COMMIT~`

QuorumSignatures.description: The aggregate signature on a certificate and who contributed to it

signers.description: Which validators signed, by position in the stake table

ResolvableChainConfig.description: A header carries either the chain config itself or a commitment the caller resolves elsewhere

missing.description: Number of missing objects, not counting pruned ones

ranges.description: Contiguous height ranges sharing one status, in ascending order

RuntimeConfigResponse.description:
The node's effective runtime configuration: CLI flags, environment and defaults merged. The
genesis and the catchup, proposal-fetcher, libp2p and L1 tuning stay on v1. No credential this
node holds is served, but a URL an operator configured with userinfo is served as given, as v1
serves it

builderUrls.description: Builders given with `--builder-urls`, empty when consensus runs with the network config's

cliquenetAdvertiseAddress.description: "host:port", with an IPv6 literal left unbracketed as v1 writes it

cliquenetBindAddress.description: "host:port", with an IPv6 literal left unbracketed as v1 writes it

genesisFile.description: Path or URL the genesis was loaded from

l1ProviderCount.description:
How many L1 RPC endpoints are configured. These URLs are the ones most often given an API
key, so only the count is served

libp2pBootstrapNodes.description: libp2p multiaddrs, empty when not configured

ShardRange.description:
Half-open range of shard indices this share holds in the encoded payload. Its length is the
storage node's VID weight

SmallRangeProof.description: A jellyfish range proof over a few payload bytes, as v1 encodes it

proofs.description: KZG proofs, ark-serialized into one TaggedBase64 `FIELD~`

SqlStorage.description: Durations are whole milliseconds, rounded down

stakeAmount.description: 0x-prefixed hex quantity, as v1 renders a U256

epoch.description:
The epoch this table is for: the one requested, or the current one. Absent on a network
without epochs. v1 reports it only on its `current` route.

StateCertV1Response.description: The certificate a light client uses to advance past an epoch boundary, first form

StateCertV2Response.description:
The certificate a light client uses to advance past an epoch boundary, with the LCV2 and LCV3
signatures side by side

lcv2Signature.description: Signature for the LCV2 light-client contract, TaggedBase64 `SCHNORR_SIG~`

lcv3Signature.description: Signature for the LCV3 light-client contract, TaggedBase64 `SCHNORR_SIG~`

StorageBackend.description: - `STORAGE_BACKEND_FS_DEFAULT`: Filesystem storage with default settings, used when no storage flag was given

rate.description:
Fraction of views in which this node decided a block. Node-local, not a network measure.
Zero before the node has seen any view, so a fresh node reports zero rather than an
undefined ratio.

SyncStatus.description:
Whether this node stores an object, still has to fetch it, or deleted it on purpose

- `SYNC_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED`: Never returned; proto3 requires a zero value
- `SYNC_STATUS_MISSING`: Not stored yet; the node fetches it from peers in the background
- `SYNC_STATUS_PRUNED`: Deleted by the pruner; the node will not fetch it again

end.description: Height just past the last one in the range (exclusive)

prunedHeight.description:
Height of the last pruned object: everything at or below it is pruned rather than missing.
Absent when nothing has been pruned

rowCount.description: Live row count: an estimate from Postgres' cumulative statistics, an exact count on SQLite

totalSizeBytes.description: On-disk size including indexes, in bytes; absent when the backend does not report it

tables.description: Largest first on Postgres, by name on SQLite

seconds.description: Seconds elapsed since this node last decided a block

TimeoutCertificate3.description: The timeout certificate the new protocol carries, whose epoch is always known

amount.description:
Total issued supply in ESP (decimal string): initial_supply +
total_reward_distributed, including rewards not yet claimed on Ethereum

Total supply of the ESP token minted on Ethereum, in ESP (decimal string);
excludes unclaimed rewards

Total rewards distributed by consensus, in ESP (decimal string), including rewards

posInNamespace.description: Position of the transaction within its namespace

decideBy.description: Last view in which the upgrade may still be decided, discarded after it

newVersionFirstView.description: First view the new version governs

oldVersionLastView.description: Last view the old version governs

authenticated.description: Whether the contract verified the registration signature

commission.description: Hundredths of a percent, so 10000 is the whole reward

delegators.description: Sorted by account; v1 reports a map, which has no order

p2pAddr.description:
"host:port", with an IPv6 literal left unbracketed. Absent for a validator that registered

stake.description: Total delegated stake, a 0x-prefixed hex quantity

stakeTableKey.description: Absent for a validator registered without one

stateVerKey.description: Absent for a validator registered without one
